I'm getting a TypeError when running my tests. Any advice on how to debug this?

A TypeError typically occurs when you try to use a variable of the wrong type. Check the error message for the specific line causing the issue. You can also add print statements in `test_version_handler.py` to see the types of variables being used. For example,

```python
print(type(my_variable))
```
This will help you trace back to the problem.
How do I set up a new branch for my feature in Git?

You can create a new branch using the following commands:
```bash
git checkout -b feature/version-parsing
```
This will switch you to a new branch named 'feature/version-parsing'. Make sure to commit any changes on your current branch before switching.
What is the best way to run tests automatically after every change in PyCharm?

In PyCharm, you can set up a file watcher to run tests automatically. Go to `File > Settings > Tools > File Watchers`, click `+` to add a new watcher, and configure it to run `pytest` on the files you want to test. This setup will allow your tests to run each time you save changes.
